raw:
{
  "question_intent": "Inquiry about business impact and customer behavior in the Middle East due to regional tensions.",
  "main_topics": ["Middle East business impact", "Customer behavior", "Regional tensions"],
  "answer_completeness": "Complete",
  "response_stance": "Direct",
  "evidence_level": "Medium",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": false,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false,
  "narrative_alignment": "Aligned",
  "question_quote": "Maybe just to start with the obvious question, given the tensions in the region, anything you're observing on your business and footprints in the Middle East, either on the client side or on your own side, in terms of frictions or changes in patterns or behaviour that we should be mindful of for the quarter?",
  "answer_quote": "Thank you, Chris. So far, we haven't seen - other than a couple of names doing more drawdowns from the obvious sectors, there's not really large drawdowns happening. We see some deposits coming in, as we always do, but it's still pretty much focused from a Middle East geographic sense as opposed to across the board. In terms of wealth products, particularly on the Private Bank side, we see some of our customers readjusting their portfolios. There's some transactional activity and the rest is pretty much the same. What we are really waiting for - and we are engaged with our customers - is to see, particularly with regard to the freight traffic slowdown and the Hormuz Strait, what is it that our customers will be doing next? We are there to support our customers, to give them more shorter term lending and, in some cases, have done so when their goods are at sea and some of those activities have slowed down. I expect, as we go into next week and beyond, we'll see more of a broader perspective. We are also not seeing any stress on our credit books at this point of time.",
  "reason": "The response directly addresses the question, providing insights into the business's current observations and expectations without numeric evidence or forward guidance, aligning with the question's focus on the Middle East."
}
